memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: For they did not come to meet you with bread and water on your way when you came out of Egypt, and they hired Balaam son of Beor from Pethor in Aram Naharaim to pronounce a curse on you. However, the Lord your God would not listen to Balaam but turned the curse into a blessing for you, because the Lord your God loves you. - Deut 23:4-5 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God explains why certain nations were kept at a distance, they had refused kindness to Israel and had even hired Balaam to curse them. But then comes a beautiful turn. God would not listen to the curse. Instead, "the Lord your God turned the curse into a blessing for you, because the Lord your God loves you." The enemy meant harm, but God transformed it into good, all because of His love.

What a stunning glimpse into God's heart and power. Others tried to bring a curse upon His people, but no curse could stand against God's love for them. He took what was meant for evil and turned it into blessing. His love was the deciding factor, stronger than any scheme against them.

This same God works powerfully on behalf of those He loves. The New Testament assures us that God works all things together for the good of those who love Him (Rom 8:28). No curse, no scheme, no evil intention can finally overcome God's purposes for His people. Supremely, we see this at the cross, where the greatest evil ever committed, the crucifixion of the Son of God, was turned by God into the greatest blessing, our salvation. If God turned that into good, He can be trusted with whatever seems to threaten you. Because God loves you, He can turn even your hardest trials into blessing. Can you trust His love in the face of what seems set against you?

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Where do you need to trust God's love against what threatens you?
2. How does the cross show God turning evil into blessing?
3. What "curse" might God be transforming into blessing in your life?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You that Your love turns curses into blessings. Help me trust that You work all things for good for those who love You. Amen.
